## Summary

- what changed
- why it changed
- what was intentionally left out

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm test:stories`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` when relevant

## UI and UX Review

- [ ] verified on mobile assumptions
- [ ] verified on desktop assumptions
- [ ] visual hierarchy still feels intentional
- [ ] no placeholder or generic template styling was introduced

## Commit History

- [ ] commit history follows `gitmoji + Conventional Commits`
- [ ] commit scopes and descriptions are clean enough to read as a changelog
